summary.name: Mattermost
summary.one_liner: Mattermost is an open-source team collaboration platform, and this page is its deployment guide for installing a server and getting desktop and mobile apps.
use_cases: Deploying a self-hosted team chat server
Installing Mattermost on Kubernetes in Azure or Oracle Cloud
Setting up Mattermost on Ubuntu or RHEL/CentOS
Connecting desktop and mobile apps to a Mattermost server
summary.what_it_does: The page is a deployment guide for Mattermost. It lists production install options, including a Mattermost Operator for Kubernetes, Azure and Oracle Kubernetes Engine guides, Ubuntu .deb packages, a RHEL/CentOS guide, and a tarball for any 64-bit Linux system. It also describes container-based installs for evaluation and testing, which the page says are not recommended for production because high availability is not supported. Every install method sets up Mattermost Entry, a free limited-use edition of Enterprise Advanced, and a license can be uploaded to unlock full access. The page also links to desktop and mobile apps and mentions webhooks, slash commands, and plugins for extending an instance.
notable: Free Mattermost Entry edition installed by default, with an option to upload a license for full access
Production deployment via Mattermost Operator on Kubernetes, with local or cloud storage and databases
Signed .deb packages via the Mattermost Personal Package Archive for Ubuntu
Desktop and mobile apps with source code linked
caveats: Container-based evaluation installs are not recommended for production because high availability is not supported
Full access requires uploading a license; Mattermost Entry is a limited-use edition
The page does not list desktop or mobile app platforms explicitly beyond the app links
